description: This file implements a key-value loader for Kubernetes configurations, including functions for reading environment files, literal sources, and file sources, with validation and parsing logic.

classes.name: loader
classes.description: A struct that reads and validates key-value pairs from various sources, including environment files, literal strings, and file sources.

methods.name: Validator
methods.description: Returns the validator used by the loader.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads key-value pairs from environment files, literal sources, and file sources, returning all pairs or an error.

methods.name: keyValuesFromFileSources
methods.description: Reads key-value pairs from specified file sources.

methods.name: keyValuesFromEnvFiles
methods.description: Reads key-value pairs from environment files.

methods.name: keyValuesFromLines
methods.description: Parses byte content into key-value pairs line by line.

methods.name: keyValuesFromLine
methods.description: Parses a single line into a key-value pair, handling comments, whitespace, and validation.
